A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

(i) the procurement push and the marketing pull are the two sides of the same coin in supply chain management, (ii) RM is an important driver in project financial success, (iii) RM is a key element of supply chain management, and (iv) the decoupling point can be moved to the start of the construction supply chain through the use of RM, thus allowing agile manufacturing to be introduced into construction.
procurement is a push strategy, and RM is a pull strategy.

the RM approach is a potentially valuable driver for supply chains to add value and improve continuously, but that it requires a shift in the mindset from procurement push to marketing pull, which is the focus of this paper.
The main takeaway from our work is that
procurement push and marketing pull are both important, and that the two are complementary.
the procurement push along the chain is not the only way to improve supply chain performance.
procurement push and marketing pull are not mutually exclusive, but can work in tandem, with the procurement push being the driver and the marketing pull being the driver of value creation.
